title: Database secrets
description: B1: the secrets scoped to the database service, as secrets.json beside its generation: the password of each role a service signs in with, which the control plane generates and keeps. At each start the database sets every role's password from this file, so a role whose password was generated again still signs in. The control plane writes it before the generation, and the database acts on neither until both carry the same generation.

generation.description: The generation these secrets belong to.

passwords.description: Each service role's password, by role.
